paragraphs: Rav Lili bar Mamal reported in the name of Mar Ukva, in the name of Shmuel, Yevamot 12a. Yuchasin reads Lili bar Mani.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The named William Davidson vocalized Yevamot 12a text explicitly gives Rav Lili bar Mamal, Mar Ukva, Shmuel as a reporting chain. יב. follows the period convention for 12a; the line break does not detach Shmuel from the chain.

Mamal and Mani remain different patronymics: Mani is the reading Hyman attributes to Yuchasin. No edition/author of that work is newly identified and no variant collation is performed. Rav and Mar are full in Hyman; Shmuel and the alternative Lili gain no extra title.
